baseline_prompt_en: One adult staff member in an exhibition hall at night arranges chairs after the visitors have left. The staff member stands beside a chair row and guides one chair back toward the row with both hands on its backrest. The chair feet remain close to the floor as the gap in the row narrows. Soft ceiling light reveals chair edges and the cleared aisle. The frame gives the last chair adjustment priority within the emptied hall.
